old_problem: The source supplies neither MODS module semantics nor MCTP endpoint/message acceptance. Binary help and USB enumeration cannot prove the intended USB 2.0 binding, EID identity or safe request/response behavior.
disposition_reason: Standard USB descriptors and generic MCTP concepts can define read-only discovery evidence, but they cannot determine whether this platform uses a native or vendor bridge, which controller/endpoint/EIDs are intended, or what proprietary MODS messages do. With Procedure and Criteria both TBD, ED-01/03/11/15/30 forbid inventing an OEM command, opcode/payload or PASS oracle. Exact vendor module, bounded non-mutating transaction matrix and independent management recovery remain genuine engineering inputs.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2200, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2201 / Wistron-HW-00482-V002 / e12128506dc1e91a was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
MODS help proves package presence only; it does not exercise USB transport or MCTP semantics, and truncated/malformed SSH is rejected.
Bind physical/logical USB controller, root port, hub/connector, VID:PID, interface/driver and exact management endpoint.
Define whether USB is a native MCTP binding or vendor bridge, with local/remote EID ownership and discovery provenance.
Approve each message type/opcode/payload, timeout, completion/response and mutation boundary; default to bounded read-only transactions.
Preserve full request/response and USB/MCTP/BMC health evidence; stop on wrong EID, unexpected opcode, reset storm, device loss or management instability.
No endpoint discovery, MODS command, message, reset, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Vendor-recipe-gated USB 2.0 MCTP transport and endpoint validation
test_case.purpose: Verify that the specified USB 2.0 route carries the approved MCTP transactions between the intended controller and management endpoint with correct endpoint identity, decoded responses and stable management health.
required_package: Signed MODS package/module version/hash/license/platform support and exact USB2 MCTP recipe
MCTP binding or vendor-bridge definition plus local/remote EID ownership
Approved bounded message type/opcode/payload/timeout/response matrix and prohibited mutations
USB reset/protocol/BMC error limits and independent management recovery plan
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the exact vendor module, USB route and MCTP message oracle. Once signed, preserve baseline topology and management health; run the approved MODS USB2 MCTP module exactly once against the bound endpoint/EID using only approved non-state-changing transactions; capture complete USB descriptors/counters plus decoded MCTP requests, responses, completions and timestamps; verify endpoint enumeration and management reachability remain stable without retry or reset.
test_case.expected_result: The exact USB route and intended endpoint/EID remain stable, every approved request produces the signed response/completion within timeout, no unexpected opcode or state mutation occurs, and USB/MCTP/BMC/kernel health stays within signed limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while the module, route, binding/EIDs or message/response matrix is TBD. After approval, wrong endpoint/EID, missing or incorrect response, timeout/error-limit breach, unexpected mutation, reset storm, device loss or management degradation is FAIL. MODS help, USB enumeration or an undecoded response alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until package/recipe, exact USB path, endpoint/EIDs, opcode-level semantics, limits and independent recovery are signed.
Reject any unapproved write, provisioning, firmware, reset or state-changing transaction before execution.
Preserve logs; no endpoint reset, log clearing, automatic message retry or autonomous management recovery.
Stop on route/EID mismatch, unexpected opcode, repeated timeout/reset, device loss, BMC instability or management-path degradation.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and MODS package/module/recipe identity
USB controller/root-port/hub/connector plus endpoint VID:PID/interface/driver mapping
Binding/bridge definition, EID discovery/ownership and signed message matrix
Full timestamped MODS stdout/stderr/exit status and decoded request/response/completion data
Pre/post USB topology, reset/error counters and MCTP/BMC/kernel/SEL health
Unexpected-action, timeout, stop/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On endpoint mismatch, reset storm, timeout/error burst, device loss or management instability, stop transactions once and preserve evidence. Use the independent signed management path and operator-owned recovery procedure; do not issue automatic retries, USB/BMC resets, firmware operations or state-changing cleanup.
